title: Maybe There Was an Egg Cartel After All
summary: This Politico investigative article explores whether coordinated cartel behavior contributed to the dramatic surge in egg prices, examining evidence of potential price-fixing in the egg industry and its impact on consumer affordability.
problem_solved: Investigates whether consumers were systematically overcharged for eggs through coordinated market manipulation.
why_valuable: Provides accountability journalism on food pricing transparency and potential corporate misconduct affecting basic consumer goods.
